response.original_title: How to Add Another Room to Your Princess Cruise Reservation
response.overview: To add another room to your Princess Cruise, contact Princess Cruise's reservation team directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK). Additional staterooms can be linked to your existing booking, subject to ship availability and applicable fares. This process cannot be completed online. Keep in mind that new rooms will be subject to current pricing and ship capacity. To add an entirely separate second room to an existing Princess Cruises booking, you cannot do it online. You must call Princess Cruises Customer Service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or contact your travel advisor to book a new cabin and link the reservations. Contact Princess Cruises or your travel agent directly since separate cabins cannot be appended via the website or mobile app.
